idea-plugin.name: StarRocks Support
idea-plugin.description:
StarRocks Support provides a dedicated StarRocks SQL dialect and database integration for DataGrip and other JetBrains IDEs with Database Tools.

Features

  • StarRocks SQL parsing and syntax highlighting.
  • Code completion for StarRocks keywords, types, functions, snippets, and table properties.
  • Platform-based SQL formatting for the StarRocks dialect.
  • Dedicated StarRocks DBMS and data source integration.
  • JDBC metadata, StarRocks type system, object resolution, and native SHOW CREATE support.
  • Syntax coverage aligned with the StarRocks 4.1 documentation baseline.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Parsing and highlighting

  • Fixed parenthesized top-level query expressions such as (SELECT 1) being reported as invalid DML.
  • Fixed CREATE TABLE target names being highlighted as function calls when followed by a column list, including qualified names and IF NOT EXISTS, EXTERNAL, and TEMPORARY forms.
  • Fixed view names followed by column lists being highlighted as function calls.
  • Fixed a materialized-view parsing regression that rejected previously supported optional clauses and clause ordering.
  • Aligned analytic-clause PSI with the platform SQL parser so window-expression aliases participate in select-list AS alignment.

Functions and inspections

  • Fixed function argument parsing and signature validation across analytic, aggregate, date/time, and UUID functions, including COUNT(*), zero-argument and precision forms, DISTINCT/ALL, function-local ordering and SEPARATOR, IGNORE NULLS, SQL-style TRIM, and bare units in TIMESTAMPADD/TIMESTAMPDIFF.
  • Added platform-style OVER clause insertion when completing analytic functions.
  • Fixed false nested-aggregate errors when an input column has the same name as a later aggregate alias.
  • Consolidated built-in function names around the platform function catalog to remove duplicate metadata.

Formatting

  • Aligned view column-list, comment, query wrapping, and indentation behavior with DataGrip formatting settings while preserving StarRocks-specific clauses.
  • Fixed excessive indentation when formatting select lists whose first item is a long function expression.
